parties: Future Consumer Limited; Committee of Creditors
headline: Future Consumer Limited: Committee of Creditors Meeting in Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
sum: Future Consumer Limited (FCL) informed the NSE of a Committee of Creditors (CoC) meeting, marking a substantive procedural step in its ongoing corporate insolvency resolution process under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016.
implication: CoC meetings are pivotal gates in IBC resolution: they vote on resolution plans, operational policies and liquidation alternatives, making the meeting date and agenda critical for stakeholder recovery timelines and exit probabilities.
detail: Future Consumer Limited, a subsidiary of the Future Group conglomerate (which operates multi-format retail and FMCG brands), has been subject to CIRP proceedings. The notification to NSE of a second CoC meeting signals progression through the statutory 180/270-day resolution window. The intimation filing indicates mandatory disclosure compliance under SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements (LODR) 2015 and IBC procedural rules, and likely precedes either a resolution plan vote, extension application, or liquidation initiation.
